title: Asanas: Yoga Poses and Their Effects | Yoga Momente
description: Nine asanas at a glance: relaxation, tree, cobra, downward-facing dog and more, with their effects and tips for your practice.

sections.title: Asanas
sections.lead: Nine yoga poses and what they do for you.

items.title: Relaxation
items.text: In the classic yoga seat you can concentrate entirely on your breath. You arrive in the here and now and with yourself. For a few moments of calm it is the perfect pose.

items.title: Tree
items.text: Find your balance on the yoga mat and in everyday life. With a firm stance and focused attention you experience stability and growth. Draw strength from your center.

items.title: Flexibility
items.text: Sitting so much every day strains our backs. Strengthen your lower back muscles and move in the opposite direction. A feel-good moment for your muscles.

items.title: Hip opening
items.text: Loosen stiff hips, improve your range of motion and ease back pain in these hip-opening yoga poses.

items.title: Chest opening
items.text: Open your heart and your shoulders in chest openers such as camel pose or fish pose.

items.title: Cobra
items.text: The pose energizes the body, relieves stress and improves concentration. The chest opening also opens the heart, letting your energy flow more freely and lifting your mood.

items.title: Downward-facing dog
items.text: Learn how to train stiff muscles safely, improve the mobility of your lower body and find the right alignment in forward-bend asanas.

items.title: Stretch
items.text: The plow helps you gain and keep flexibility. Tension in the shoulders and neck can release, thyroid function is normalized and the abdominal organs receive a gentle massage.

items.title: Standing
items.text: The dynamic posture stabilizes the whole body. It promotes inner strength, concentration, focus and balance, harmonizes, grounds and strengthens the leg muscles of the standing leg and the core.

sections.title: Try it out.
sections.text: In class I show you how to practice the asanas safely and in a way that suits your body.
